summary: Cricket records, mega-budget Bollywood movie updates, and star trades generate the highest viewer interest and engagement on the channel. Technical automobile news, stock market updates, and general news updates lack emotional pull and underperform consistently. Shifting focus entirely to high-stakes Indian sports stats and viral movie lore in Hinglish titles with strong visual hooks will drive retention. Maintaining a strict focus on fast-paced, 45-second stories with flawless seamless loops will help hit monetization goals.
do_more: Lead scripts with shocking stat breakdowns or unexpected player record feats in the first 2 seconds
Focus on major Indian cricket icons like Arshdeep, Hardik, Rohit, and Kohli, plus blockbuster cinema announcements
Keep script length under 45 seconds to maximize completion percentage and automatic loop plays
Include an intriguing question at 35 seconds to drive comments and retention right before the seamless loop
avoid: Avoid reporting dry financial updates like gold rates, stock movements, and defense share news
Stop covering niche car launches, generic auto sales stats, or technical specs
Avoid covering low-interest international sports events without a strong Indian player connection
Eliminate long background intros; get straight to the central conflict or record in line one

title_tips: Start titles with player or movie names in ALL CAPS like HARDIK PANDYA or RAMAYANA
Add high-emotion emojis at the end of titles (😱, 🏏, 🔥, 🎬)
Keep titles under 55 characters so the full text remains visible on mobile screens
